metadata.location: Bharatpur-7, Opposite Cancer Hospital, Chitwan, Nepal
metadata.disclaimer: दरहरू समयअनुसार परिवर्तन हुन सक्छन्। विशेष परीक्षण, नमुना वा बाह्य रेफरल परीक्षणको शुल्क फरक हुन सक्छ। परीक्षण गराउनु अघि आवश्यक परे प्रयोगशालाबाट हालको शुल्क पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्।
metadata.notice: Official diagnostic test rates for Bimal Pathology & Diagnostic Center, Bharatpur, Chitwan.

tests.name: Blood Sugar (Fasting) / FBS
tests.preparation: Strict 8–10 hours overnight fasting required (water permitted)
tests.description: Baseline blood glucose measurement for diabetes evaluation.

tests.name: Blood Sugar (PP) / PPBS
tests.preparation: Sample collected exactly 2 hours after starting meal

tests.name: Random Blood Sugar (RBS)
tests.preparation: No preparation needed; spot glucose test
tests.description: Immediate blood glucose check for acute assessment.

tests.name: HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin)
tests.preparation: No fasting needed; any time of day
tests.description: Gold standard 3-month average glucose control assessment.

tests.name: Glucose Tolerance Test (GTT / OGTT)
tests.preparation: 8–10 hrs fast; includes standard glucose drink
tests.description: Diagnostic evaluation for gestational diabetes and impaired glucose tolerance.

tests.name: Liver Function Test (Complete LFT)
tests.description: Bilirubin (Total & Direct), SGOT, SGPT, ALP, Total Protein, Albumin, Globulin, A:G Ratio.

tests.name: Bilirubin (Total & Direct)
tests.description: Total Bilirubin, Direct (Conjugated) and Indirect for jaundice evaluation.

tests.name: SGPT (ALT - Alanine Aminotransferase)
tests.description: Specific liver enzyme for acute hepatocellular injury and hepatitis.

tests.name: SGOT (AST - Aspartate Aminotransferase)
tests.description: Enzyme marker for liver and tissue cellular injury.

tests.name: Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP)
tests.description: Enzyme marker for biliary obstruction and bone disorders.

tests.name: Albumin
tests.description: Liver synthetic protein marker for nutritional and hepatic status.

tests.name: Total Protein
tests.description: Measures total serum albumin and globulin proteins.

tests.name: Total Protein & Albumin (A:G Ratio)
tests.description: Total Protein, Albumin, Globulin, and calculated Albumin-Globulin ratio.

tests.name: Gamma GT (GGT / GGTP)
tests.description: Sensitive marker for biliary disease, alcohol impact, and fatty liver.

tests.name: Renal Function Test (Complete RFT / KFT)
tests.preparation: Maintain normal hydration; avoid heavy meat dinner
tests.description: Serum Creatinine, Blood Urea, BUN, Serum Uric Acid, eGFR calculation.

tests.name: Serum Creatinine
tests.description: Key clinical biomarker for kidney glomerular filtration function.

tests.name: Blood Urea / BUN
tests.description: Measurement of urea nitrogen cleared by the kidneys.

tests.name: Serum Uric Acid
tests.preparation: 4–8 hours fasting preferred; avoid alcohol prior day
tests.description: Evaluation for gout arthritis, hyperuricemia, and renal calculi.

tests.name: Electrolytes (Na+ / K+ / Cl-)
tests.description: Ion-selective electrode assay for electrolyte balance and hydration.

tests.name: Serum Calcium (Total)
tests.preparation: Fasting preferred; avoid calcium supplements morning of test
tests.description: Bone mineral metabolism and parathyroid status evaluation.

tests.name: Serum Phosphorus / Phosphorous
tests.description: Renal phosphate clearance and calcium-phosphorus bone homeostasis.

tests.name: Lipid Profile Package (Full Panel)
tests.preparation: Strict 10–12 hours overnight fasting required (water permitted)
tests.description: Total Cholesterol, Triglycerides, HDL (Good), LDL (Bad), VLDL, Ratios.

tests.name: Total Cholesterol
tests.description: Total circulating blood cholesterol measurement for cardiovascular risk.

tests.name: Triglycerides (TG)
tests.preparation: Strict 10–12 hours fasting; avoid fatty dinner and alcohol
tests.description: Blood lipid fraction linked with metabolic syndrome and vascular health.

tests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC / Hemogram)
tests.description: Hb, TLC, DLC (5-part Differential), Platelet Count, RBC Indices, ESR.

tests.name: Hemoglobin (Hb)
tests.description: Total hemoglobin concentration for anemia assessment.

tests.name: TC / DC (Total & Differential Leucocyte Count)
tests.description: Total and differential white blood cell count for infection screening.

tests.name: ESR (Westergren)
tests.description: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate for systemic inflammation.

tests.name: Peripheral Blood Smear (PBS / PS Morphology)
tests.description: Detailed microscopic morphology of red blood cells, WBC, and platelets.

tests.name: Blood Grouping & Rh Type
tests.nepaliName: रक्त समूह र आर.एच. (Blood Group & Rh)
tests.description: ABO blood group and Rh(D) factor typing with certification.

tests.name: Reticulocyte Count
tests.description: Measures bone marrow red blood cell production activity.

tests.name: Bleeding Time / Clotting Time (BT / CT)
tests.description: Screening for primary hemostasis and coagulation prior to surgery.

tests.name: Prothrombin Time with INR (PT / INR)
tests.description: Extrinsic pathway evaluation and oral anticoagulant therapy monitoring.

tests.name: APTT (Activated Partial Thromboplastin Time)
tests.description: Intrinsic coagulation pathway evaluation and surgical bleeding risk.

tests.name: D-Dimer (Quantitative Assay)
tests.description: Fibrin degradation marker for Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT), PE, and DIC.

tests.name: Urine Routine & Microscopic (R/E)
tests.nepaliName: पिसाबको नियमित तथा सूक्ष्म जाँच (Urine R/E)
tests.preparation: First morning midstream clean urine in sterile container
tests.description: Physical, chemical (Protein, Sugar, Ketone, Bile), and microscopic analysis.

tests.name: Urine Pregnancy Test (UPT)
tests.preparation: Early morning concentrated urine sample gives best sensitivity
tests.description: Rapid qualitative detection of human Chorionic Gonadotropin (hCG).

tests.name: 24 Hours Urine Protein
tests.preparation: Collect all urine passed in 24 hours; keep container cool
tests.description: Quantification of daily proteinuria for nephrotic syndrome and renal disease.

tests.name: Microalbumin / Creatinine Ratio (UACR)
tests.preparation: Early morning first void preferred; avoid heavy exertion
tests.description: Early detection of diabetic nephropathy and renal microvascular disease.

tests.name: Urine for Bence Jones Protein (BJP)
tests.description: Thermal / chemical screening for free light chains in Multiple Myeloma.

tests.name: Ketone / Acetone Bodies (Urine)
tests.description: Screening for diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) and starvation ketosis.

tests.name: Stool Routine Examination (R/E)
tests.nepaliName: दिसाको नियमित तथा सूक्ष्म जाँच (Stool R/E)
tests.description: Consistency, color, mucus, plus microscopic Ova, Cysts, Pus cells, and RBC.

tests.name: Occult Blood (Stool / FOBT)
tests.preparation: Avoid red meat, iron supplements for 48h prior if advised

tests.name: H. Pylori Antigen (Stool)
tests.nepaliName: एच. पाइलोरी एन्टिजेन - दिसा (H. Pylori Stool)
tests.description: Definitive non-invasive stool antigen test for active Helicobacter pylori infection.

tests.name: Semen Analysis (Routine & Morphology)
tests.preparation: Strict 3 to 5 days of sexual abstinence; deliver within 30–45 mins
tests.description: Volume, Liquefaction, Total Sperm Count, Motility, and Morphology.

tests.name: Troponin-I (Rapid Card)
tests.description: Qualitative rapid immunoassay for cardiac troponin I.

tests.name: Troponin-I (Quantitative / High Sensitive)
tests.description: High sensitivity fluorescence immunoassay for acute myocardial infarction.

tests.name: CPK-MB
tests.description: Myocardial enzyme marker for heart muscle injury assessment.

tests.name: CPK Total
tests.description: Enzyme marker for skeletal and heart muscle breakdown.

tests.name: NT-proBNP (Quantitative)
tests.description: Gold standard biomarker for congestive heart failure diagnosis and monitoring.

tests.name: Serum Amylase
tests.description: Digestive enzyme marker for acute pancreatitis and salivary gland inflammation.

tests.name: Serum Lipase
tests.description: Highly specific pancreatic biomarker for acute pancreatitis.

tests.name: LDH (Lactate Dehydrogenase)
tests.description: General biomarker for cellular injury, tissue breakdown, and hemolysis.

tests.name: ADA (Adenosine Deaminase)
tests.sample: Pleural / Ascitic / CSF Fluid or Serum
tests.preparation: Aspirated body fluid or routine blood
tests.description: Biochemical marker for tuberculous effusion and lymphocytic pleurisy.

tests.name: G6PD (Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase)
tests.preparation: Test when patient is not in acute hemolytic crisis
tests.description: Evaluation for G6PD enzyme deficiency and drug-induced hemolytic anemia.

tests.name: Dengue (Combo) Test (NS1 Antigen + IgM/IgG Antibody)
tests.preparation: Any day of suspected dengue illness
tests.description: Complete dengue panel detecting NS1 antigen and acute/convalescent antibodies.

tests.name: Scrub Typhus Antibody (IgM)
tests.preparation: Routine collection during acute febrile illness
tests.description: Serodiagnosis for vector-borne Orientia tsutsugamushi mite fever in Chitwan.

tests.name: Widal Slide Agglutination
tests.description: Slide agglutination for Salmonella enterica serotypes (TO, TH, AH, BH).

tests.name: Typhoid IgM/IgG (Typhi Dot)
tests.description: Rapid chromatographic detection of Salmonella typhi specific IgM and IgG.

tests.name: Kala-azar (rK39 Rapid Strip)
tests.preparation: Routine collection for prolonged fever / splenomegaly
tests.description: Visceral leishmaniasis recombinant rK39 antibody detection.

tests.name: HIV 1 & 2 Rapid Screening
tests.description: Rapid screening immunoassay for HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies.

tests.name: HBsAg Hepatitis B Screening
tests.description: Screening for Hepatitis B viral surface antigen.

tests.name: HCV Antibody Screening
tests.description: Screening for Hepatitis C viral antibody.

tests.name: HAV IgM Antibody
tests.description: Diagnostic antibody for acute Hepatitis A infection and acute jaundice.

tests.name: HEV IgM Antibody
tests.description: Diagnostic antibody for acute Hepatitis E infection.

tests.name: H. Pylori Antibody (Blood)
tests.nepaliName: एच. पाइलोरी एन्टिबडी - रगत (H. Pylori Blood)
tests.description: Serological total antibody detection for Helicobacter pylori exposure.

tests.name: VDRL / RPR (Syphilis Screening)
tests.description: Nontreponemal flocculation test for syphilis screening.

tests.name: TPHA (Treponema Pallidum Hemagglutination)
tests.description: Specific treponemal confirmatory hemagglutination test for syphilis.

tests.name: MHA-TP (Microhemagglutination Assay for T. pallidum)
tests.description: Advanced microhemagglutination treponemal test for syphilis confirmation.

tests.name: CRP (Qualitative)
tests.description: Rapid slide latex screening for acute phase C-Reactive Protein.

tests.name: CRP (Quantitative / Turbidimetric)
tests.description: Quantitative measurement of C-Reactive Protein concentration in mg/L.

tests.name: ASO (Qualitative)
tests.description: Latex agglutination screening for Anti-Streptolysin O antibodies.

tests.name: ASO (Quantitative)
tests.description: Quantitative determination of Anti-Streptolysin O titre in IU/ml.

tests.name: RA Factor (Qualitative)
tests.description: Latex screening for Rheumatoid Factor in suspected rheumatoid arthritis.

tests.name: RA Factor (Quantitative)
tests.description: Precise quantitative determination of Rheumatoid Factor concentration in IU/ml.

tests.name: Total IgE
tests.description: Quantitative measurement of total Immunoglobulin E for allergic disorders and atopy.

tests.name: Urine Culture & Sensitivity
tests.sample: Clean Catch Midstream Urine in Sterile Container
tests.preparation: Clean external genitalia; first morning midstream preferred
tests.description: Aerobic culture, colony count, and automated/disc antimicrobial susceptibility.

tests.name: Stool Culture & Sensitivity
tests.description: Isolation of enteric pathogens (Salmonella, Shigella, Vibrio, E. coli) and antibiotic sensitivity.

tests.name: Blood Culture & Sensitivity
tests.sample: Venous Blood inoculated in BACTEC/Brain Heart Infusion Broth
tests.preparation: Strict aseptic skin preparation before fever spike
tests.description: Gold standard diagnostic for bacteremia, septicemia, and enteric fever.

tests.name: Sputum Culture & Sensitivity
tests.sample: Deep coughed morning sputum in sterile container
tests.preparation: Rinse mouth with clean water; cough deeply from bronchial tree
tests.description: Respiratory pathogen identification and antibiotic sensitivity.

tests.name: Pus / Wound Discharge Culture & Sensitivity
tests.sample: Sterile swab / aspirate of wound discharge or pus
tests.preparation: Aseptic collection before topical or systemic antibiotics
tests.description: Aerobic pathogen culture and antibiogram profiling.

tests.name: Gram Stain
tests.sample: Smear of pus, discharge, fluid, or sputum
tests.description: Rapid differential microscopic identification of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.

tests.name: AFB Stain (1st & 2nd Sample / Ziehl-Neelsen)
tests.sample: Deep coughed sputum or body fluid
tests.preparation: Morning deep cough specimen; avoid saliva
tests.description: Ziehl-Neelsen acid-fast staining for Mycobacterium tuberculosis detection.

tests.name: KOH Preparation (Fungus Direct Examination)
tests.sample: Skin scraping, nail clipping, or hair root
tests.preparation: Clean area; avoid antifungal ointments on collection day
tests.description: Potassium hydroxide mount for direct microscopic fungal hyphae/spores visualization.

tests.name: Wet Mount Examination
tests.sample: Vaginal discharge / bodily fluid on fresh slide
tests.description: Direct microscopic examination for Trichomonas vaginalis, clue cells, and yeast.

tests.name: Mantoux Test (Tuberculin Skin Test - TST)
tests.preparation: In-lab intradermal injection; mandatory reading after 48–72 hours
tests.description: Cell-mediated immunity assessment for tuberculosis infection.

tests.name: PAP Smear (Cervical Cytology)
tests.sample: Cervical cytology smear fixed in 95% ethyl alcohol
tests.preparation: Avoid douching or vaginal medications 48h prior; avoid during menses
tests.description: Screening for cervical pre-cancerous intraepithelial lesions and cervical cancer.

tests.name: Liquid Based Cytology (LBC - Pap / Non-Gyn)
tests.sample: Cervical brush in liquid preservative vial
tests.description: Enhanced thin-layer cervical and non-gynecological cytology with superior cell clarity.

tests.name: FNAC (Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology)
tests.sample: Fine needle cellular aspirate on slides
tests.description: Rapid cytological diagnosis of lumps, lymph nodes, thyroid nodules, and breast masses.

tests.name: Biopsy (Small Tissue)
tests.sample: Tissue specimen in 10% neutral buffered formalin
tests.description: Histopathological grossing, processing, microtomy, and expert biopsy evaluation.

tests.name: Biopsy (Medium Tissue)
tests.preparation: Proper volume of formalin (10:1 formalin to tissue ratio)
tests.description: Histopathology examination for medium resected surgical specimens.

tests.name: Biopsy (Large Tissue)
tests.description: Comprehensive histopathological examination for large organ resection specimens.

tests.name: Bone Marrow Aspiration / Biopsy
tests.sample: Bone marrow aspirate smears and core biopsy
tests.description: Evaluation for leukemia, multiple myeloma, myelodysplastic syndrome, and aplastic anemia.

tests.name: IHC (Immunohistochemistry) Panel
tests.preparation: Representative tissue block with pathology report
tests.description: Diagnostic tumor categorization, lymphoma subtyping, and hormone receptor status.

tests.name: Thyroid Function Test (TFT - T3, T4, TSH)
aliases: thyroid function test (tft - t3, t4, tsh)
tests.preparation: Morning collection preferred; note thyroid medication
tests.description: Standard thyroid tri-panel assessing Total T3, Total T4, and ultrasensitive TSH.

tests.name: Free TFT (FT3, FT4, TSH)
tests.nepaliName: फ्री थाइरोइड प्रोफाइल (Free TFT - FT3, FT4, TSH)
tests.preparation: Morning collection preferred; note thyroid medication
tests.description: Active unbound circulating FT3, FT4 and pituitary TSH evaluation.

tests.name: Anti-TPO Antibody
tests.description: Autoimmune thyroid marker for Hashimoto's thyroiditis and Graves' disease.

tests.name: Vitamin D (25-OH Total)
tests.description: Quantitative determination of total 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D (D2+D3) for bone & immune health.

tests.name: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin)
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting (8h) preferred; avoid B12 injections prior to test
tests.description: Immunoassay for megaloblastic anemia, neuropathy, and nerve health.

tests.name: Serum Ferritin
tests.description: Primary storage iron biomarker for iron deficiency and overload assessment.

tests.name: Iron Profile (Serum Iron + TIBC + UIBC + Transferrin)
aliases: iron profile (serum iron + tibc + uibc + transferrin)
tests.preparation: Morning fasting sample required; avoid iron tablets 24h prior
tests.description: Comprehensive evaluation of circulating iron, transferrin saturation, and binding capacity.

tests.name: Folic Acid / Folate
tests.description: Serum folate evaluation for megaloblastic anemia and pregnancy nutrition.

tests.name: Beta-HCG (Quantitative)
tests.description: Precise quantitative confirmation of pregnancy, ectopic pregnancy, and trophoblastic disease.

tests.name: Prolactin (PRL)
tests.preparation: Morning sample 2–3 hours after waking; rest 20 mins before draw
tests.description: Pituitary hormone for galactorrhea, amenorrhea, and infertility workup.

tests.name: FSH (Follicle Stimulating Hormone)
tests.preparation: Day 2 or 3 of menstrual cycle for females
tests.description: Ovarian reserve, menopausal status, and spermatogenesis assessment.

tests.name: LH (Luteinizing Hormone)
tests.description: Pituitary gonadotropin evaluating ovulation, PCOS, and fertility.

tests.name: Testosterone (Total)
tests.preparation: Morning collection (7:00 AM – 10:00 AM) when levels peak
tests.description: Primary androgen evaluation for male hypogonadism and female hirsutism/PCOS.

tests.name: Progesterone
tests.preparation: Typically collected on Day 21 of a 28-day cycle (mid-luteal)
tests.description: Confirmation of ovulation and luteal phase sufficiency.

tests.name: Serum Insulin (Fasting / PP)
tests.description: Assessment of insulin resistance, HOMA-IR, and hyperinsulinemia.

tests.name: Serum Cortisol
tests.preparation: Morning (8:00 AM) or evening (4:00 PM) collection as advised
tests.description: Adrenal glucocorticoid function for Cushing's syndrome and adrenal insufficiency.

tests.name: DHEAS (Dehydroepiandrosterone Sulfate)
tests.description: Adrenal androgen marker for congenital adrenal hyperplasia and hirsutism.

tests.name: PTH (Intact Parathyroid Hormone)
tests.preparation: Morning fasting sample preferred with calcium
tests.description: Primary regulator of calcium homeostasis for hyper/hypoparathyroidism.

tests.name: Growth Hormone (GH)
tests.preparation: Overnight fasting and complete physical rest prior
tests.description: Pituitary growth hormone evaluation for acromegaly and growth disorders.

tests.name: PSA (Total - Prostate Specific Antigen)
tests.preparation: Avoid ejaculation, cycling, or DRE exam for 48h prior
tests.description: Prostate health evaluation and screening for prostate cancer/BPH in men.

tests.name: Free PSA
tests.preparation: Avoid ejaculation, cycling, or DRE exam for 48h prior
tests.description: Free/Total PSA ratio for distinguishing benign prostatic hyperplasia from malignancy.

tests.name: CA 125 (Ovarian Marker)
tests.description: Ovarian tumor marker for epithelial ovarian cancer monitoring and pelvic mass workup.

tests.name: CA 15.3 (Breast Marker)
tests.description: Tumor biomarker for therapeutic monitoring and recurrence in breast cancer.

tests.name: CA 19.9 (GI / Pancreatic Marker)
tests.description: Carbohydrate antigen marker for pancreatic adenocarcinoma and cholangiocarcinoma.

tests.name: CEA (Carcinoembryonic Antigen)
tests.description: Broad gastrointestinal, colorectal, and lung tumor surveillance marker.

tests.name: AFP (Alpha-Fetoprotein)
tests.description: Primary tumor marker for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and testicular germ cell tumors.

tests.name: ANA (Antinuclear Antibodies - IFA / Screen)
tests.description: Primary gold standard screening test for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) and connective tissue diseases.

tests.name: Ds-DNA (Anti-dsDNA Antibody)
tests.description: Highly specific confirmatory biomarker for SLE and lupus nephritis disease activity.

tests.name: Anti-CCP (Anti-Cyclic Citrullinated Peptide)
tests.description: Highly specific early marker for erosive Rheumatoid Arthritis.

tests.name: ANA Profile (Immunoblot / 18 Panel)
tests.description: Comprehensive 18-antigen line immunoblot (Ro/SSA, La/SSB, Sm, RNP, Scl-70, Jo-1, Centromere, Ribosomal P, etc.).

tests.name: ANCA, PANCA, GBM Panel
tests.nepaliName: एन्का / प्यान्का / एन्टी-जिबिएम (ANCA / PANCA / Anti GBM)
tests.description: Comprehensive vasculitis panel for Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis, Microscopic Polyangiitis, and Goodpasture syndrome.

tests.name: Quadruple Marker (Quarde / Second Trimester Screening)
tests.preparation: Accurate ultrasound gestational age and maternal weight required
tests.description: Second-trimester prenatal screening (AFP, hCG, uE3, Inhibin-A) for Down syndrome, Trisomy 18, and open neural tube defects.
